user_intention: 同样时间内学得更强、更稳定；主动寻找其他候选，不再等待B停滞门槛才诊断。
source_policy: Latest mutually completed B boundary, full model/upper+lower Adam/RNG/240 environments per rank preserved before any diagnostic.

diagnostic.split: Fixed seeded split of whole (env,episode) trajectories, never randomly split decisions from one game.

measurements: old-to-final complete categorical KL on fixed legal-action probes; single-legal-action and multi-action distributions separate, by phase and tails
unseen-whole-game clipped surrogate with frozen old advantages, reported as a diagnostic not achieved win-rate gain
old/new critic bias, MSE and explained variance against natural Monte Carlo returns on held-out whole games
actual actor/critic Adam counts, full sample reuse, update wall and process-tree CPU/RSS/Torch/VRAM/device GPU telemetry
exact control-repeat state equality and original policy/Adam/lower/RNG restoration
selection: Reject nonfinite, failed exact-repeat/restore, skipped/censored games, or cross-rank inconsistency. A single fixed-cohort surrogate cannot prove online benefit; select at most one candidate for separately bounded paired online continuation.

online_confirmation.status: Not launched; candidate chosen after diagnostics
online_confirmation.initialization: Identical verified boundary bundle, all optimizers/RNG/environments preserved, separate run identities, four ranks sequentially exclusive.
online_confirmation.comparison: Equal19200 natural games and common completed-round wall, final two5-round windows; require +0.5pp win or +2floor in both and no material win/common-time regression. Report all windows, exclusions, uncertainty and single-replica limitation.

candidate_interpretation.batch3072: Smaller optimizer batch changes Adam count and noise; fresh game count remains960. Shared effective batch affects both independent networks.
candidate_interpretation.actor_epochs4: More actor reuse only, critic four epochs unchanged; tests optimization effort not additional independent experience.
candidate_interpretation.actor_lr24: Actor LR only; original clip and critic remain unchanged.
candidate_interpretation.critic_lambda097: Frozen old-value lambda returns for critic only; actor advantages unchanged. Introduces bias/variance tradeoff, not a reward/terminal change.
